historical_priority: Provisional relative to the examined literature; a previously published exact biclique specialization cannot be categorically excluded.
limitations: Two indistinguishable particles at stationary equilibrium on complete bipartite graphs, one exchange clock per occupied-vacant edge, with accepted-jump count only; no higher cumulants or complete counting-law convergence.
scientific_integrity: Proof uses an exact reversible Poisson equation; finite verification is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof. Universal count-variance identity and the Poisson equality classification are credited prior results.
title: Bipartition-balance reversal in two-particle exclusion activity on complete bipartite graphs
